title: Faster home-screen widget refresh
summary: For the site owner: the Field monitor widget's refresh answers in well under its 4-second limit again, so it stops showing "Could not refresh" when the server was only slow.
items: A refresh measured 4.1 seconds on the server, just past the widget's 4-second limit. The widget now waits at most 0.4 seconds for GitHub and Cloudflare before using their previous dated reading (it waited 1.2 seconds).
The phone's check-in is saved while the reading is built instead of before it, and independent database reads run together.
Readings, diagnostics and history are unchanged, and every widget route still requires the owner role.
